# a note to self, dropped on conversion

The converter turns org files into Obsidian notes. See [[file:second-brain.org][the vault note]]
for how the inbox is organised.

* DONE Parse the easy constructs :parser:
CLOSED: [2026-10-28 Wed 11:15]
:LOGBOOK:
CLOCK: [2026-10-28 Wed 09:00]--[2026-10-28 Wed 11:15]
:END:
Headings, paragraphs and /inline markup/ all work. The tricky part was org's
word-boundary rule: without it =some_variable_name= loses a chunk.

** Constructs covered
- headings and paragraphs
- lists, including
  - nesting
  - [ ] checkboxes
  - [X] and finished ones
- tables :: with alignment
- blocks
